mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM PRODUCT WHERE IS_AVAILABLE = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_RECOMMEND (PRODUCT_ID, RECOMMENDED_PRODUCT_ID, RANK_ORDER, BASIS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{recommendedProductId}, #{rankOrder}, #{basis}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT RECOMMENDED_PRODUCT_ID AS recommendedProductId FROM PRODUCT_RECOMMEND WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY RANK_ORDER ASC
